<entry id="I00613">
<head-word>טָעֲמָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>pleader.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<plural-form>Pl. טָעֲמַיָּא</plural-form>. Esth. R. to I, 3 בני ט' ובני סגניא דיליה his young pleaders and counselors. Ib. בני ט' בני … דיליה 
<italic>pleaders</italic> means his counsellors.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00614">
<head-word>טָעַן, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. טָעָה) [
<italic>to seek, ask</italic>, (cmp. בְּעָא),] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to claim</italic> before court, 
<italic>to sue, to plead.</italic></definition>
<notes> Keth. XIII, 4 הטוֹעֵן את חבירו כדי וכ' if one claims from his neighbor a certain number of jugs of oil. Ib. 108
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. טְעָנוֹ חטין וכ' if one claims wheat and barley (two different things), and defendant admits barley. Shebu. 43
<sup>a</sup> עד שיִטְעֲנֶנּוּ בדבר וכ' until he sues him for something weighable or countable. Gitt. 58
<sup>b</sup> טוֹעֲנִין ליורש וכ' the court pleads in behalf of the heir &c.; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. טָעוּן, f. טְעוּנָה 
<italic>is required for, requires</italic>. Zeb. V, 7 דמן ט' הזייה their blood is required for sprinkling (must be sprinkled). Bicc. II, 1 טְעוּנִים רחיצת וכ' require washing of hands; a. v. fr.—Denom. טֹעַן, טוֹעַן 
<italic>requirement, obligation</italic>, fr. which טָ' טֹעַן 
<italic>to require</italic>. Sifra introd. ויצא מן הכלל לִיטְעוֹן ט' אחר שהוא וכ' and is specified for another requirement in keeping with the general subject.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to seek after, to suspect</italic>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִטְעַן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be sued, to be respondent, defendant</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Kam. X, beg. 7
<sup>b</sup> אפי' קטנים נִטְעָנִין להן בב"ד even for minors defense is made in court (prob. to be read: טוֹעֲנִין, cmp. Gitt. 58
<sup>b</sup>, quoted supra). [In later literature טוֹעֵן 
<italic>claimant</italic>, נִטְעָן 
<italic>defendant</italic>.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be inquired after, suspected, to be summoned on suspicion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. II, 8 הנ' על א"א וכ' if one was suspected of intercourse with a married woman, and the court caused her to be sent away from him (her husband) on his account; ib. 24
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. ib. IV, 5 הניט' מא"א. Y. ib. II, 4
<sup>a</sup> bot. בנ' בעדים when the suspicion has been corroborated by witnesses.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="I00615">
<head-word>טְעַן, </head-word>
<head-word>טְעֵין</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to plead</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 105
<sup>b</sup> אי בעי טָעֵין וכ' if he chooses, he may plead thus. Gitt. 58
<sup>b</sup> אי דקא טעין וכ' is it that he pleads (demurs) and says &c.?; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00616">
<head-word>טָעַן, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="I00594"> cmp. טָעָה</xref>,
<xref rid="unknown"> טַעֲיָיא</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , a. Ges. H. Dict.
<sup>10</sup> s. v. 
<xref rid="unknown">צען</xref>) [
<italic>to move, make ready for travelling</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (cmp. נָשָׂא) 
<italic>to load, pack up</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 6 וטוֹעֲנִים על העגלות and pack (them) upon wagons; a. fr.—Part. pass. טָעוּן (interch. with טוֹעֵן) 
<italic>laden, carrying</italic>. Ib. s. 5 מי שהוא ט' בקרשים some had a share in carrying (moving) the boards. Ib. טוענין כל כלי האריגה had to carry all woven materials. Ib. s. 6 היה מִטּוֹעֲנֵי וכ' was one of those carrying the ark. B. Mets. 32
<sup>b</sup> טְעוּנָה יין אסור carrying forbidden wine.—Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII בשעה … טְעוּנִין את המים when the clouds are charged with water; Yalk. Sam. 160 טוענין מן המים (corr. acc.), v. חָשַׁךְ. Ib. אלו טוענין חרבות וכ' those carrying swords, others lances &c.; a. fr.—3) Esp. 
<italic>to help one broken down on the road to load again</italic>, contrad. to פרק to help in unloading. B. Mets. II, 10 מצוה לִטְעוֹן … the biblical law requires man to help in unloading, but not in loading (without remuneration); אף לט' loading, too, must be done gratuitously, v. טְעִינָה; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִטְעַן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be laden</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 82 נ' ברכות was laden with blessings; a. e.—Trnsf. (cmp. כָּבֵד) 
<italic>to be very ill</italic>. Treat. S’maḥ. ch. VIII אמר לו נ' he said to him, He (thy son) is very ill.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be carried</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXVII [read:) אינן יכולין להִטָּעֵן … וטוֹעֲנִין וכ' who cannot be carried (on wagons &c.) … and they carry them on their hands (in a chair); (v. next w. a. Yalk. Ps. 838).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִטְעִין</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lade, put on</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 13 ה' לחמורו וכ' he put on his ass five S’ah &c. Sabb. 5
<sup>a</sup> הִטְעִינוֹ חבירו his neighbor placed something in his hand to carry, ה' שמים the heavens placed &c. (when he put his hand forth to collect and carry rain water); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to carry goods for sale</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah I, 16
<sup>a</sup> top (ref. to Lev. XIX, 16) שלא תהא כרוכל הזה מַטְעִין דבריו וכ' be not like the peddler carrying the talk of this one to the other &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="I00617">
<head-word>טְעַן, </head-word>
<head-word>טְעֵין</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be laden; to carry, bear</italic> (h. נשא).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. II Num. XIII, 23 (ed. Amst. טַעֲנוּ 
<italic>Pa.</italic>). Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 1. Targ. Joel II, 22; a. fr.—B. Mets. 40
<sup>b</sup> כיון דטָעוּן טָעוּן when they are once impregnated (with the fluid), they resorb no more.—Trnsf. 
<italic>to suffer, bear</italic>. Targ. Prov. IX, 12; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lade, to harness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XLV, 17 טְעוּנוּ ed. Berl. (oth ed. a. Y. טְעִינוּ). Targ. Y. ib. XLIV, 13.—Esp. 
<italic>to help carrying</italic>, opp. פרק, v. preced. Gen. R. s. 96 משל הדיוט … טעון וכ' the common adage says, if thy friend’s son is dead, help carrying; if thy friend is dead, throw off (common people show no favor where no return can be expected). Y. Ḥag. II, 77
<sup>b</sup> top מִיטְעוֹן תרי וכ' that two carry one load; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>טַעֵין</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Ib. הוון מְטַעֲנִין להין they made them carry &c.—Part. pass. מְטַעַן 
<italic>carried, moved</italic>. Cant. R. to IV, 8 דלית אינון … מְטַעֲנִין וכ' who are too feeble to be carried in a 
<italic>lectica</italic>, and whom they carry in a 
<italic>cathedra</italic></notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַטְעֵין</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to carry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. מַטְעִינִין. Y. Ḥag. l. c. אַטְעוּנְנוֹן יחידאין carry them singly, אַטְעוֹנִינוֹן וכ' they did so; אטעונינון צלוחיין carry straight through (without resting).—א' חינא = h. נשא חן 
<italic>to find grace</italic>. Targ. Esth. II, 17 (ed. Lag. אִיטְּ', 
<italic>Ithpe.</italic>); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיטְּעַן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be laden</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Lam. V, 5. Targ. Esth. l. c., v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be carried</italic> (in a chair).</definition>
<notes> Y. Bets. I, 60
<sup>c</sup> bot. מִיטְּעַן מערס וכ' allowed himself to be carried from one seat (where he lectured) to another. Ib., v. סְדִינָא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="I00616">preced.</xref>
<italic>Nif.</italic>) 
<italic>to become severely ill</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Sam. XII, 15 (h. text ויאנש).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="I00618">
<head-word>טְעַן, </head-word>
<hw-number>III</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to move to and back, to swing</italic> a whip &c. Num. R. s. 12 דלא יהוון טַעֲנִין וכ' that they should not swing the rod over the children (Midr. Till. to Ps. XCI … מחון; Yalk. Ps. 842 מחיין).</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa., part. pass.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מְטַעַן</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>swung upon, struck</italic> with a spear &c., 
<italic>wounded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XIV, 19 מְטַעֲנֵי חרב (h. text מְטֹעֲנֵי). Targ. Jer. XXXVII, 10 מְטַעֲנִין (h. text מדקרים); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="I00620">
<head-word>טַעֲנָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (טָעַן I) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>plea, suit, claim</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Shebu. VI, 1 הט' … וההודאה וכ' if the claim is for two M’ah silver, and the defendant admits the value of a P’rutah. Ib. אם אין ההודאה ממין הט' if the defendant’s admission is not homogeneous with the claim (e.g. one sues for wheat and the defendant alleges to owe barley). Ib. 39
<sup>b</sup> כפירת ט' שתי וכ' the claim of two M’ah in the Mishnah means that amount of the claim which is disputed; ט' עצמה וכ' it means that the original claim was for two &c. Keth. I, 1 טַעֲנַת בתולים, v. בְּתוּלִים.—B. Kam. 57
<sup>a</sup> ט' גנב, v. גַּנָּב. Ib. ט' לסטים, v. לִסְטֵיס; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. טַעֲנוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Snh. III, 21
<sup>b</sup> bot. צריך … לשנות טַעֲנוֹתֵיהֶן the judge must repeat the pleas of the contesting parties; Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXII לשקול ט'; Yalk. Kings 175 לשקול ט' בפני שניהם weigh their pleas in the presence of both parties; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>suspicion, talk, fault-finding</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 10 (ed. Amst. p. 240
<sup>a</sup>) מפני טענת הבריות not to give rise to people’s talk; Ab. d’R. N. ch. II. Y. Ber. I, 3
<sup>c</sup> מפני ט' המינין not to give support to the talk of the heretics (Bab. ib. 12
<sup>a</sup> תרעומת).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00621">
<head-word>טַעַנְתָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>plea</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 28
<sup>a</sup> האי ט' מעליית' היא is not this a good plea?—
<plural-form>Pl. טַעֲנָתָא</plural-form>. Keth. 18
<sup>a</sup> כולהי ט' טענת וכ' all pleas consist of the claim of other people and one’s own admission (replique).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (טָפַף, v. 
<xref rid="D00955">דָּפוּס</xref>) 
<italic>frame, mould.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. XVI, 7 ט' של תפלה the block on which the case of the phylacteries is shaped. Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>d</sup> top ט' של פעור a cast of the idol P’or; (Sifré Num. 131 דפיס; Snh. 106
<sup>a</sup> יראתה). Y. Sabb. IV, 8
<sup>b</sup> bot. ט' של דדים, v. דָּפוּס. Dem. V, 4 (ed. Y. טִיפּוּס). Y. ib. 24

<entry id="I00636">

<language-reference>
<xref rid="I00676"> cmp. טפף I)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to join closely</italic>, whence טֶפַח (cmp. קוֹמֶץ) 
<italic>joined fingers, hand-breadth</italic>,] 
<italic>to come in close contact</italic>; (cmp. נָקַשׁ) 
<italic>to strike, knock</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 32
<sup>b</sup> נתזה בקעת וטָפְחָה לו על פניו Ms. M. a chip flew off and struck him in the face. Ib. נתזו … וטָפְחוּ לו וכ' Ms. M. sparks flew off and hit him &c.; a. fr.—Esp. (denom. of טֶפַח) טָפַח, a.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>טִיפֵּחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strike with the flat hand, to slap</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 22, end התחיל אדה"ר מְטַפֵּחַ על פניו Adam slapped his own face; Lev. R. s. 10 טוֹפֵחַ. Kidd. 31
<sup>a</sup> טָפְחָה לו על ראשו slapped him on his head. Gen. R. s. 45 טְפָחַתָּהּ וכ' (Yalk. ib. 79 קפחתה) she slapped her face with her shoe. Y. Kil. VIII, 31
<sup>c</sup> top טי' כנגד וכ' (Kidd. 24
<sup>b</sup> הכהו) if he struck him over his eye and blinded him. Ab. Zar. IV, 10 היה מְטַפֵּחַ על וכ' (Bab. ed. 60
<sup>b</sup> מַטְפִּיחַ, Y. ed. מתפח) he slapped upon the fermenting barrel (to check fermentation). Toh. III, 8 שדרך התינוק לטַפֵּחַ a child likes to 
<pgbrk id="pg546" />slap (dough &c., to dabble); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to clap hands</italic> to a certain tune in rejoicing or mourning, v. 
<xref rid="I00413">טִיפּוּחַ</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. V, 2 לא מְטַפְּחִין וכ' we must not clap hands, or strike upon the knees, or stamp on the Holy Day. M. Kat. III, 8 מענות אבל לא מְטַפְּחוֹת may sing the dirge but must not clap. Ib. 9. Num. R. s. 4 … שהיה מקיש וטוֹפַחַ he knocked his hands against each other and clapped; ib. וטפח. Cant. R. to II, 14 מְטַפַּחַת באגפיה clapped her wings.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to collect the contents of a broken vessel by palming, to wipe with the palm.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ter. XI, 7. Sabb. 143
<sup>b</sup> ולא יְטַפֵּחַ בשמן must not use the palm for collecting oil in the broken vessel.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<entry id="I00638">
<head-word>טָפַח, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. טָפַף II) 
<italic>to drip, be moist</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 17
<sup>a</sup> עדיין משקה טוֹפֵחַ וכ' moisture is still dripping on them. Yoma 78
<sup>a</sup> טוֹפֵחַ ע"מ להַטְפִּיחַ moist enough to moisten other objects; Ab. Zar. 60
<sup>b</sup> טופח ע"מ להטפיח Ms. M. (ed. ט' להט'). Toh. VIII, 9; a. fr.—2) (cmp. דאב, דוי) 
<italic>to melt, decay, ferment</italic> (of a running and fermenting dough). B. Mets. 59
<sup>b</sup> אף בצק … ט' (Ms. R. 2 תפח, v. תָּפַח) even the dough under the hands of the kneading women fermented.—Y. Yeb. XII, end, 13
<sup>a</sup> וטפח רוחי עלי; Yalk. Prov. 964 טָפְחָה וכ' my mind in me became fermenting, i.e. I felt proud (v. טוּף).—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. טָפוּחַ 
<italic>decaying, languishing</italic> (from starvation). Sifra B’ḥuck. Par. 2, ch. VI טְפוּחֵי רעב (v. תָּפַח).</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִטְפִּיחַ</binyan-form>

<sense>

<italic>to moisten, wet</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> טינא מַטְפַּחַת clay which makes wet (those sitting on it). Ib.; Ab. Zar. 60
<sup>b</sup> להַטְפִּיחַ, v. supra. Ber. 25
<sup>a</sup> כל זמן שמַטְפִּיחִין as long as the spot is wet enough to moisten.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="I00660">

<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to join, add</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to paste, line.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. III, 4 וטְפָלָן בגללין and lined them (the cracked vessels) with a paste of ordure. Ib. 5 הטוֹפֵל וכ' if one covers with paste a sound vessel. Bets. 34
<sup>a</sup> אין טוֹפְלִין וכ' you must not cover (the fowls) with potter’s clay (to get the feathers off); Tosef. ib. III, 19 וטובלין ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.). Sabb. 80
<sup>b</sup>; Pes. 43
<sup>a</sup>; M. Kat. 9
<sup>b</sup> טוֹפְלוֹת אותן בסיד dress their skins with lime (to keep them hairless). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40
<sup>d</sup> (in Chald. diction) שחוק וטְפוֹל grind it to powder and apply it (as a remedy); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to add, join</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥag. 8
<sup>a</sup> בטוֹפֵל when he combines two different funds. Ib. טוֹפְלִין בהמה לבהמה וכ' you may use the second tithe money for buying an additional animal to that designated for the pilgrim’s offering (חֲגִיגָה), but you must not join the two funds (in order to buy a larger animal). Ab. Zar. 25
<sup>b</sup> טוֹפְלוֹ לימינו lets the gentile walk to his right side, v. זָמַן; (Tosef. ib. III, 4 נותנו); Ḥull. 91
<sup>a</sup>.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. טָפוּל a) 
<italic>affixed, attached</italic>. Y. Sabb. XVI, 15
<sup>c</sup> bot. (ref. to Mish. ib. 2) בשאינו ט' לו וכ' when the casing is not attached to the book, but if it is &c.—b) 
<italic>dependent on, supported by</italic>. Y. Dem. II, 23
<sup>a</sup> top; Y. Peah IV, 18
<sup>b</sup> bot. טְפוּלִין לאביהן dependent on (living with) their parents (cmp. B. Mets. 12
<sup>b</sup>, s. v. סָמַךְ).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִטְפַּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be attached, affixed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 6; s. 15; Yalk. Is. 281 ונִטְפְּלוּ בישעיה and they were embodied in the Book of Isaiah. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 17 נִטְפַּלְתֶּם בעצמי you will be attached to myself (be called sons of Jacob); Yalk. Gen. 161; (Gen. R. s. 100 זכיתם בעצמי you will have a share in me).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. זָוַג) 
<italic>to meet, join</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 91
<sup>a</sup> ישראל שנ' וכ', v. זָמַן. Men. 65
<sup>a</sup> ניט' להם וכ' R. J. joined their discussions. Snh. 9
<sup>a</sup> הני' לעוברי עבירה he who is an accessory to sin. Y. B. Kam. X, 7
<sup>c</sup> top, שלא … נִטְפָּלִין לגנבים that citizens may not be in conspiracy with thieves (and sell the stolen goods to their owner under the pretence of having bought them).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to attend to, to nurse, tend</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Keth. XII, 35
<sup>a</sup> top מי שני' … יִטָּפֵל בי וכ' those who attended to me (nursed me) in life, shall attend to me in death; Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> top; Gen. R. s. 100; Tanḥ. Vayḥi 3. Ib, a. e. להִטָּפֵל בקבורתו to attend to his funeral; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִיטַּפֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. B. Kam. 10 same.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 10
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. הבעלים מִטַּפְּלִין וכ' the owner has to attend to the disposal of the carcass. B. Mets. 28
<sup>b</sup> מִטַּפֵּל בהן must take care of them. Ex. R. s. 20; Deut. R. s. 11 אני בעצמי מט' וכ' I myself shall attend to thy burial; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of lower animals) 
<italic>to breed, increase</italic> (v. 
<xref rid="I00660">טָפֵל</xref>).</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 80
<sup>a</sup> ושרצים … מִיטַּפְּלִין שם vermin and frogs breed in the house.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pu.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>מְטוּפָּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of טָפֵל) 
<italic>burdened with a large family</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 16
<sup>a</sup>, sq. מט' ואין לו one having a large family with no means of support.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
